newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Baobab buys 25.1 pct stake in Voicematix.
newsitem.headline: Baobab buys 25.1 pct stake in Voicematix.

text.p: South African investment company Baobab Solid Growth Ltd has acquired a 25.1 percent stake in specialist voice processing company, Voicematix, the companies said on Thursday.
The remainder of Voicematix is held by its management.
Baobab managing director Nic Adams said the acquisition, for an undisclosed sum, reflected its confidence in Voicematix's long-term growth potential.
"Our decision to become involved in the voice processing business is in line with our commitment to the new wave technology industry where we see considerable opportunities," he said.
